title: Resolve indeterminate backlog checks with current-code consequences or explicit runtime gaps

source.ref: Frozen full consequence sweep and logging-only instrumentation, 2026-10-23

detail:
A frozen full sweep runs 1,739 probes: 1,722 agree and 17 return indeterminate rather than claiming a result. Logging-only instrumentation names LIVE-016, LIVE-040, OWN-032, LIVE-047, LIVE-051, LIVE-107, LIVE-089, LIVE-139, SCAN-713, SCAN-715, SCAN-762, SCAN-784, SCAN-797, SCAN-798, SCAN-802, SCAN-810 and LIVE-884. Most source checks predate route groups or replaced contracts; unavailable proof is not an application regression and is not a pass. Restore each original consequence against the active seam, make missing mandatory source fail rather than silently return 79, and keep mutation controls. LIVE-040 genuine visual capture and LIVE-884 fresh shared-ISR runtime evidence remain explicitly distinct from source checks. First batch reanchors OWN-032 and SCAN-715 to the (marketplace) group and replaces SCAN-762 permissive source text with AST form wiring plus actual pending-state SSR of HousingSubmit and Button. All three pass locally; four synthetic reintroduced-bug controls must fail. Twelve source/retired-contract checks and the two artifact/runtime gaps still need reconciliation. Do not delete probes, forge capture commits, weaken privacy/financial assertions or widen budgets to close this row.

Second batch restores SCAN-784 and SCAN-810 against actual unified route exports and pure helpers, with synthetic fixtures and four negative controls. Five original source checks now pass meaningful current-code consequences. Ten remaining source/retired-contract checks plus LIVE-040/LIVE-884 artifact/runtime gaps remain; no fresh aggregate outcome count is inferred before another frozen sweep.

Third batch restores SCAN-797/798/802 with current guide publication/schema/share consequences and eleven assertion-level negative controls. Eight of fifteen source checks are reconciled; seven source/retired-contract checks plus the two artifact/runtime gaps remain. Public market cache repeat now has read-only production HIT/public/no-new-cookie evidence; an actual approved nonpublic fixture remains missing for its privacy half.

Fourth batch restores LIVE-047 against the actual CPU parser and executable cost assertions, with six assertion-level regression controls. Nine of fifteen source checks are reconciled; six source checks and two artifact/runtime gaps remain. No cost budget or aggregate sweep result changed.

Fifth batch restores SCAN-713 against the current durable settlement seam, with eight assertion-level regression controls, 43 existing mocked checkout tests and seven exact-function disposable SQL scenarios. Ten of fifteen source checks are reconciled; five source checks and two artifact/runtime gaps remain.

Final source batch reconciles LIVE-051/016/089/107/139 against current catalog, transcript, dialog, navigation and canonical event-card seams, with 25 assertion-level negative controls. All fifteen original source checks are reconciled. LIVE-040 visual capture provenance and LIVE-884 complete public/private cache evidence remain explicit artifact/runtime gaps; rerun the frozen aggregate before reporting a new outcome count.

After integrating current main #3882, re-measured LIVE-040: its minimum-15 floor is obsolete because the canonical visual gate excludes published Home and expects 14 sets. A derived-set probe now preserves FAQ/schema/coverage/stamp consequences and passes four assertion controls plus 12 existing FAQ tests. This reclassifies the original 17 cases as 16 restored source/capture-metadata checks and one genuine full-runtime gap, LIVE-884. Authenticated visual acceptance remains separately open in LIVE-312. The prior frozen network sweep on 58ab49fe9 recorded 1,739 agreements and two indeterminate cases; no new aggregate is inferred before another sweep.

Scoped reconciliation complete: final frozen network-enabled sweep on 0bc6bc419 exits zero with 1,740 agreements and only LIVE-884 indeterminate. All original source/capture-metadata gaps are restored; the real cache privacy fixture gap is explicitly named and not passed. Full audit remains open in SCAN-1032, and this closure is not a cost, authenticated visual or production acceptance claim.

verify.evidence: Frozen network-enabled full sweep on 0bc6bc419: exit 0, 1,741 probes asked, 1,740 agree, only LIVE-884 explicitly indeterminate. All sixteen original source/capture-metadata cases restored with assertion-level regression controls; canonical public/private cache capture remains owner-fixture dependent and is not counted passed. LIVE-312 authenticated visual acceptance stays open. Cost contract remains unproved and unchanged.
